character: ONE voice (Cam S, ElevenLabs 53CG2aO2HU48thT3QnMl): the partner who asked 'which one's cheapest?', telling it on himself at the kitchen bench. Dry, under-played Kiwi bloke, general NZ accent, never a caricature, no announcer lift, no exclamation marks. He explains what the screen does the way you'd tell a mate, and the self-own ('I'd have picked that one.') is the laugh. The 'Him' bubbles on screen are his own asides; the white captions are phrases lifted from the same narration. Continuous speech: the narration never stops for more than 1 s. An AI voice of a fictional person, never presented as a real customer.

continuous_read_v3:
Which one's cheapest? Trick question. Looks like the seventy-four hundred, or this one, or this. Depends how you read them.

The emailed one goes in too, once I've checked it. One table: bold's what they wrote, grey's the maths.

Excluding GST, Steamline's lowest. Flip it and, hang on, it moved. Trev. That's what we pay.

Seventy-four hundred plus GST is eighty-five ten. Never the cheapest. [amused] I'd have picked that one.

Open one, see what it covers. Queue Ess Mee doesn't pick the winner. It stops GST picking it for you. Sign up at Queue Ess Mee dot Co dot N Z.
